in_marathi.name: Deveshay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of divine powers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deveshay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deveshay is a combination of two Sanskrit words, 'Deva' meaning god and 'Ishaya' meaning lord or master. This name signifies the one who holds divine powers and is the master of all.
